name: Southern Blood

tenures.source: Dazz's Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire roleplays (the draft, the titles won from The Sisterhood, Herrera leading the team) and Chapter 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial (the champions, still Southern Blood).

caption: A tag team of the brothers Jay and Lance Williams, led by Eric Herrera, who took the Tag Team titles from The Sisterhood in 2009 and were split between the Mayhem and Livewire shows by the draft after the last Mayhem of the year.

name: Hostile Takeover

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts, Charged Chamber, Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire.

caption: A group formed by Malakai Laymon against his brother Jacob, whose Nick Cagero, Lilith Evans and Denile Partis lost to Dazz, Kayla Jones and Axl Evermore at Deadly Conflicts.
